title: Party roster read API
description: Add a read API that lists every PC in the party instead of only the active character. readStateSnapshot currently reads a single character and AssembledContext.state.character is singular. Add listParty(db) (and a party-aware snapshot) returning compact roster entries (id, name, class, level, HP, conditions, active flag) for role='pc', with companions/familiars (non-pc role) available under a separate roster grouping. Foundation: schema v9 already multi-row; no migration. Acceptance: listParty returns all PCs ordered deterministically; active PC flagged; companions distinguished by role; unit tests cover solo (one-member), multi-PC, and companion cases.
close_reason: listParty read API added with 4 unit tests; npm run check/typecheck/test all green (743 passed). Committed 69b6fbe.
